run_default_ppo_config: run the default PPO algorithm configuration with 30 agents and Adam optimizer
run_pybullet_cheetah_config: run the PPO configuration for the HalfCheetah Bullet environment with 100M training steps
run_pybullet_minitaur_config: run the PPO configuration for MinitaurBulletEnv with motor model and PD control enabled
run_pybullet_humanoid_config: run the PPO configuration for the Humanoid Bullet environment with 300M training steps
run_pybullet_kuka_grasping_config: run the PPO configuration for the Kuka grasping task with 10M training steps
